# Documentation (generated by experiments/generate_docs_index.py — do not edit by hand)

Generated by `experiments/generate_docs_index.py` on 2026-10-17 at commit be41ec1-dirty from configs/documentation_registry.json, each registered document's first heading; do not edit by hand.

This project builds a signed, typed physiology graph (genes and the proteins they encode, metabolites and reactions, signalling, transcription, electrical and drug-mechanism layers, brain cell classes) and models how a perturbation, an allele of a gene or a drug, propagates through it to psychiatric symptom constructs, so that the learned mechanisms can serve as the basis of a new psychiatric nosology. The [repository README](../README.md) is the overview; this page is the map of the documents.

Each document has a class, which says how far to trust it as a statement of the present ([documentation process](documentation_process.md)): **living** documents are kept current and reviewed; **records** are dated and corrected only by dated additions; **generated** documents are written by the script they name and carry its stamp; **frozen** documents are pinned by their hash; **drafts** await the owner. What is current is in [status](status.md), not in memory.
